text:
Mina: Quick FYI  signoff window next week clashes with several managers' travel. We need a lightweight contingency/playbook so calibration export stays sane.
PeopleOpsBot: Signoff export status: 12 managers pending, 4 flagged OOO.
Carlos: Can we define "delegation" in the form export so calibration leads don't see duplicates? Right now it's ambiguous.
Mina: Yes. Proposed fields: delegated_by, delegated_reviewer, delegate_flag=true, and delegate_note. People Ops will reconcile export before sharing.
Jen: Also add a short "delegate checklist" that we can paste into messages to delegates. Something like: 1) confirm assigned in form; 2) read manager bullets (3 examples); 3) add DELEGATED: prefix in calibration notes; 4) flag any rating mismatches.
Raj: SGTM. Also recommend a small taxonomy for why delegation happened (travel, hiring, emergency) so calibration leads can filter. Add column delegate_reason.
Zoe: If we end up with a lot of delegations, what's the threshold to extend the signoff window?
Mina: Proposed rule: if >7 delegations requested OR >15% managers missing signoff at T-minus 24h, extend by 48h. Otherwise assign backups and keep timeline.
Carlos: I'll start assigning backups for the teams I cover. If I assign, how do I mark it?
Mina: Two options: managers can add delegate in the form (preferred). If they're unavailable, People Ops can mark delegated_reviewer in export after an OK from the manager's director. Either way, delegate must be visible in the export.
Jen: Quick ask: can People Ops publish a tiny flow diagram in the playbook? e.g., "Manager OOO -> Attempt form delegation -> If no response within 4h, People Ops assign backup -> Notify calibration leads." Makes it easy to follow.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: managers with "out:" notations will be pinged in 90 minutes.
Raj: out: Thu-Fri (customer onsite). Can cover one handoff Fri morning though.
Zoe: out: Wed-Thu. Delegating to Lina.
Carlos: out: Thu. Delegating to Marcus (he confirmed).
Mina: Tally so far: 3 outs. If no more replies in 2 hours, People Ops will begin backup assignments and update the export. I'll also post the delegate checklist and a short template message managers can copy into the form comments.
Jen: Template message idea: "Delegated to <name> while I'm OOO (dates). Delegate brief: <1-2 bullets>. Contact People Ops for questions"
Mina: Nice. Also adding an audit column "delegation_confirmed_ts" so we can track timeliness.
PeopleOpsBot: Delegation workflow doc link posted: /docs/perf/review-delegation-playbook.md (draft).
Carlos: One more thing  calibration packet: if delegate provides a different rating, how should we capture manager context?
Mina: Delegates should add a short note: "DELEGATED: differing rating vs manager draft. Reason: <brief>". People Ops will surface those rows to calibration leads with manager follow-up if needed.
Raj: OK I'll update the forms I touched. Thanks team.
Mina: I'll publish final contingency plan in this thread by EOD and update PeopleOpsBot with any deadline changes. Closing loop for now.
